project_type: Next.js 16 App Router (TypeScript, Tailwind 4) web app in a self-hosted Supabase monorepo. Coach uses typed Mastra tools over OpenRouteService.
build_system: npm (Next.js build). App is at app/. Coder runs on the HOST filesystem, not in Docker. Docker app service mounts an anonymous node_modules volume (gotcha #16) so a host npm install does NOT reach the container — but this task does not touch running containers.
test_framework: Vitest 3.2.7. Tests are co-located *.test.ts next to source (e.g. src/lib/ai/splits.test.ts, src/lib/integrations/strava/errors.test.ts, src/lib/ai/tools/index.test.ts). Supabase is stubbed/offline in unit tests.
verification_instructions: After code changes: (1) npm run build in app/ (runs the TS check) MUST pass — this is the bar before claiming done. (2) npm run test for any item with unit/integration tests. (3) npx eslint on EVERY new client component — repo eslint flags react-hooks/set-state-in-effect as an ERROR that npm run build does NOT catch (gotcha #28). (4) Confirm the ORS key never appears under a NEXT_PUBLIC_ name or as a query param (security).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in by build. database.ts types are hand-maintained (Database = any) — update them by hand; do NOT rely on supabase gen types (no live DB).
environment_constraints: Do NOT run migration 014 against any DB — migrations are applied MANUALLY (gotcha #4). Do NOT touch/restart running Docker containers. The coder runs on the host; install maplibre-gl via host `npm install maplibre-gl` in app/. Never push commits. Commit locally on the branch only.
contribution_requirements: Typed Mastra coach tools ONLY, no MCP (gotcha #20). TOOL SCHEMA RULE (gotcha #36): every model-facing optional field MUST be .nullable().default(null), never bare .optional(); no .min/.max/.uuid on model-supplied values; validate/clamp inside execute; a tool must NEVER throw (it silently kills the chat turn) — return a structured result like {needsLocation:true,message} instead. ORS key is a SERVER secret: never to the browser, never NEXT_PUBLIC_, never logged; raw coordinates never logged plaintext. No hover-only interactive controls (gotcha #23) — mobile-first, touch-friendly. Client fetches use the http() wrapper (gotcha #18), not raw fetch. Supabase clients come from @/lib/supabase/server (createClient/createAdminClient) — never instantiate directly.
key_patterns: Integration shape mirrors app/src/lib/integrations/strava/: client.ts (thin HTTP client + sentinel error string consts + classifyXError(status,body)->Error|null), errors.ts (xErrorResponse(err)->{status,message}). API routes: `export const runtime = 'nodejs'`, auth via `const supabase = await createClient(); const {data:{user}} = await supabase.auth.getUser(); if(!user) 401`. Dynamic route params are a Promise in Next 16: `{ params }: { params: Promise<{id:string}> }` then `await params`. Pipeline is lng-first everywhere (ORS, GeoJSON, MapLibre); only navigator.geolocation is lat-first -> centralize fromGeolocation(pos)->[lng,lat]. Existing map (activity-map.tsx) uses react-leaflet; the NEW route map uses maplibre-gl (settled decision 'pick maplibre') — do NOT refactor the old one. Avoid setState in useEffect; derive via useState(()=>...) or set inside a .then (see strava-settings.tsx).

The /plan view is a stub with no session card, so nothing is attached now.
settled_decisions: ORS provider, endpoint-configurable via ORS_BASE_URL (default https://api.openrouteservice.org) + ORS_API_KEY. Round-trip loops via POST /v2/directions/foot-walking/geojson with options.round_trip + elevation:true + instructions:false (ORS uses [lng,lat]). Flat vs uphill: <=3 candidate seeds, pick by computed ascent (flat=min, uphill=max), best-effort, always return requested-vs-actual distance. Location priority: explicit coord -> geocoded placeText -> browserCoord -> profile home (profiles.home_lat/home_lng/home_label) -> latest activity_streams latlng first point -> NO_LOCATION sentinel (chat tool returns {needsLocation:true}). Map: maplibre-gl dynamic-imported ssr:false, inline keyless OSM raster style (NOT the ORS key) behind one swappable constant, bounded-height container. Home location on profiles, editable in Settings via PATCH /api/profile/home-location. Mobile-first throughout.
